name: Workbench

pages.text: Craft a workbench using cobblestone and any kind of wood planks.

pages: First step is to add fluid to the workbench.$(br2)For metals, you can add metal ingots or blocks to the upper left slot and smelt them down with a fuel item, like you would in a furnace.
To get water or lava in the fuel slot, simply add the appropriate bucket.$(br2)A fuel source (coal, etc.) is not needed for transferring via buckets.
The tank holds 4 buckets (4,000mb) worth of fluid. 1 block of iron = 1 bucket of molten iron.$(br2)JEI contains all of the recipes.

Next, you can craft whatever the desired item is by putting the remaining elements in the crafting grid, like you would a crafting table. After this, it works similar to a crafting table, but will also use up the appropriate amount of fluid in the tank.$(br2)Note: fluids must be added to the workbench before adding the crafting items.

To remove fluid from the workbench, add a fluid basin to a crafting slot.  This fluid basin can be added back to the smelting slots to add the fluid to the workbench. This makes swapping between molten metals easy.
